headline: Profit jumps y/y, but adjusted earnings slip q/q
summary_short: Alcoa Q3 2026 revenue was $3.70B (-7% q/q, +24% y/y); net income was $483M ($1.81/share) and adjusted EBITDA $789M, down $112M q/q.
summary_long: Revenue fell 7% sequentially as lower aluminum shipments and prices outweighed higher alumina prices. Alumina output rose 11% q/q on better stability at Pinjarra; aluminum output rose 2%. Net income rose to $483M helped by mark-to-market gains on Ma'aden shares and energy contracts. Adjusted EBITDA fell to $789M. Operating cash flow was $643M and free cash flow $472M; cash ended at $4.4B including financing for the AliGroup acquisition, expected to close in H1 2027. 2026 production and shipment ranges were reaffirmed.
confidence_notes: Revenue y/y and q/q are from the release's headline table (3Q26 $3,704M, 2Q26 $3,966M, 3Q25 $2,995M). Shard EPS of 1.82 is adjusted EPS; GAAP EPS is $1.81. Cash balance includes $2.6B raised for the AliGroup acquisition.

drivers.explanation: Aluminum segment revenue fell on lower shipments and lower realized prices; alumina segment revenue rose on higher prices and shipments.
Favorable mark-to-market on Ma'aden shares and energy contracts, lower production costs and higher alumina prices, partly offset by lower aluminum prices and shipments.
Improved production costs and higher alumina prices were more than offset by lower aluminum prices and shipments.
Company expects to hold Q3's operating performance in Q4, with higher production and shipments in both segments.
